creator: Alexander Terp
description: The vt-1.0.0 move (a_2vgzMmJ4x) landed without a new baseline: ./dev --perf refuses on a busy machine and the machine was loaded all night. Upstream measured parsing 1.3-3.7x faster, and a faster run passes at tolerance 1.5, so a later regression hides in the gap until the baseline is re-recorded.
title: Re-record perf/baseline.json at vt-1.0.0 on a quiet machine
